label: Fire danger days, summer
description: Days per summer (June–August) with High, Very High or Extreme fire danger
details: FWI ≥ 18 · June–August 2040–2069 · mean of 4 CMIP6 models · SSP5-8.5
method: Days per summer (June–August) on which the Canadian Fire Weather Index (FWI) is 18 or more: the High (18–28), Very High (28–35) and Extreme (35 and over) fire danger ratings of the Alaska Interagency Fire Danger Operating Plan, as used by the SNAP API (summer_fire_danger_rating_days, earthmaps.io/fire_weather). Mean per summer over 2040–2069 for each model, then the mean of four bias-corrected CMIP6 models (CNRM-CM6-1-HR, EC-Earth3-Veg, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0) under SSP5-8.5. Source: SNAP's CMIP6 fire weather data release (Young, Littell & Rupp 2025, doi:10.5066/P1AAMRUF; the same data as Rasdaman cmip6_fwi and the API), local file cmip6_fwi_combined.nc, 0.25° (about 25 km) cells, interpolated (bilinear) to the 1 km grid. Land outside the release's boreal region has no fire weather data and counts as Low.
na_label: outside the boreal area (no fire weather data)
pros: Easy to say: "about N days a summer of high fire danger"
Uses Alaska's own fire danger ratings (Interagency Fire Danger Operating Plan), as SNAP's fire weather API does
Counts the bad days, so a few severe weeks are not averaged away
The models mostly agree on where (rank correlation 0.78–0.97)
cons: No fire weather data outside the boreal region (about 60 % of Alaska's land: most of the Arctic, the South and much of the West), so it counts as Low there, though tundra fires do happen
Nearly the same map as Variants B and C (rank correlation 0.96–0.98)
The models differ a lot in how many: MRI-ESM2-0 has a median of under 1 day, the others 8–10
Summer only (June–August): misses spring fire weather (Fairbanks peaks in late May)
Weather only: says nothing about fuel
About 25 km cells: no detail below that
SSP5-8.5 only (high emissions): doesn't match Variant A or the permafrost index (RCP 4.5)
sources: SNAP CMIP6 CFFDRS fire weather, data release v2 (local cmip6_fwi_combined.nc; = Rasdaman cmip6_fwi)
Young, A.M., Littell, J., and Rupp, S., 2025, USGS data release, doi:10.5066/P1AAMRUF
